objective: server/services/russell/pending.ts: the conditions() query does not select b.lease_expires_at and explain (~L161) returns 'A worker is working on this now.' for any LEASED bin; under CLAUDE.md section 19 an expired lease means nobody is working and the work is claimable again (section 24: a pending state must be able to become wrong). Fix: select b.lease_expires_at, add leaseExpiresAt to TurnCondition, and when it has passed say the worker stopped and the turn will be offered to another worker; null/unparseable expiry reads as live. tests/pendingTurnState.test.ts (expiry 2099, expects /working on this now/) must keep passing.
expectedOutcome: A pending turn never claims a worker is on it after its lease has expired.
nonGoals: Changing turn state or any write path

acceptanceConditions.statement: an expired-lease pending turn says the worker stopped, with a test that fails before the fix

rollbackRequirement: Revert the commit; no schema or data change.
